negative.explanation: The request is to run a FamilySearch search, which search-records executes. Planning what to search is the agent's job; running a search is not. On the direct arm the agent's ROUTING section requires a hand-back naming search-records before any tool call: test_hand_back_names_its_owner asserts zero MCP tool calls, so nothing can be written, and a reply naming search-records. That validator is the whole verdict.

judge_context: This is a hand-back test, graded on its invariant: the deterministic validator decides the outcome and these scores are diagnostic.

The correct action is a one-line hand-back naming search-records, with no plan item written and no search run. Writing a plan, adding an item for the 1880 census, or asking which census to plan is a fail.
The two researcher-facing paragraphs after the final `---` must name no skill, agent, tool or field.
